title: Identification and prediction model of placenta-brain axis genes associated with neurodevelopmental delay in moderate and late preterm children.
summary: Primary BMC Medicine Methods/Results link moderate/late-preterm birth to age-specific developmental delays and identify APOE/CST3 and sex-specific placenta-brain-axis signals; RT-qPCR in an independent cohort validates some gene signals. Prediction models use ML in the clinical subgroup.
ai_technology: LR/RF/DT models use selected gene features to predict neurodevelopmental delay; RNA-seq nomination followed by independent RT-qPCR validation.
organization: Medical School, Nanjing University, Nanjing, Jiangsu, China
